major_modelling_decisions: Represented discount factors as exp(-z(T)T), guaranteeing positivity while allowing negative rates and non-monotone discount factors.
Built a simple weighted standalone-yield PCHIP baseline before the advanced cash-flow-level spline estimator.
Used natural-cubic zero-rate knots with a second-derivative penalty, spread/liquidity weights, and five iterations of Huber reweighting for the advanced estimator.
Centered robust residual scores within repeated instrument-type/maturity groups so coherent unusual tenor shapes are not collectively rejected.

Held out complete half-year maturity buckets to prevent same- and near-maturity leakage; the baseline was selected because advanced holdout normalized RMSE worsened by 35.40% despite better training fit.
Used fixed seed 1729 for the 10% removal stability study and deterministic optimizers/settings throughout.
Defined 2Y/5Y/10Y/30Y piecewise-linear key-rate hats as a partition of unity and verified their aggregate against parallel DV01.
self_identified_weaknesses: Initial baseline PCHIP admitted isolated maturity-bucket spikes and an implausible 85% forward; fixed with a three-point median stabilizer and explicit forward guardrails.
Initial residual scales and absolute Huber scores over-flagged coherent unusual tenors; fixed with wider numerical floors, additional tenor knots, and within-tenor centering.
Per-type maximum weight normalization could erase stale/illiquid penalties when every observation was weak; removed after a failing test exposed it.
Initial validation omitted maturity-date, start-year, payment-frequency, and off-market quote checks; added explicit audit and weight behavior.
Initial repricing charts compressed ordinary residuals behind large outliers; changed both residual panels to symmetric-log scales.
Initial HTML report hard-coded the benchmark valuation date; changed the report interface to use the CLI valuation-date argument and added an end-to-end assertion.
unresolved_limitations: Instrument effective dates, issue dates, business-day calendars, accrued interest, and full production cash-flow dates are unavailable.
Validation covers one valuation date and maturity-block holdouts, not a historical backtest or realized hedge P&L.
Flat-zero extrapolation beyond the fitted domain makes long-end forwards and risk dependent on the terminal knot.
Unit correction is peer- and range-based and therefore requires source-owner review for genuinely isolated low or negative quotes.
DV01 and key rates exclude bond credit/liquidity spread risk, optionality, funding effects, and portfolio nonlinearities.
benchmark_integrity_incidents: During a package-install check, an editable-install freeze command automatically displayed parent Git remote metadata. It was not requested, not used in the solution, and subsequent installation checks used a non-editable build.
